title: Upekkhā
text: 1-6 Sāvatthi || || Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando || pe || Vippasannāni kho te āvuso Sāriputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto || katamenāyasmā Sāriputto ajja vihārena vihāsīti || || 7 Idhāham āvuso sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa-domanassānam atthagamā adukkham asukham upekkhā satipārisuddhim catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || || 8 Tassa mayham || pe || vuṭṭhito ti vā ti || ||
